title: Wedding Invitation Templates Mini Bundle
author: rosedigitaltr
description:
Make the arrangements you want at your wedding and save money by purchasing these elegant, stylish wedding invitation set templates, which are very easy to edit. You’ll need a FREE Canva account to open and edit templates. Edit your way for free in Canva using your computer (recommended), laptop or mobile device. Once you’ve edited and downloaded, just print!
WHAT IS INCLUDED
Wedding Invitation Templates:
• 4″x6″
• 5″x7″
• 1080 x 1920 px editable Electronic Invitation
• 1125 x 2436 px editable Electronic Invitation
Thank You Card Templates:
• 4″x6″ (US)
• 5″x7″ (US)
• A6 – 105x148mm (UK/AU)
• A5 – 148x210mm (UK/AU)
RSVP Card Templates:
• 5″x3.5″ front face
• 5″x3.5″ back face
DON’T FORGET
NO PHYSICAL ITEM WILL BE SENT. YOU ARE ONLY BUYING A DIGITAL FILE.
WHAT CAN YOU EDIT WITH CANVA?
• You can edit the texts and add other text.
• You can change the font size, style and color.
• You can use your photos after uploading them to the uploads section in the CANVA items section on the left.
• Background can be edited and colored.
DOWNLOAD OPTIONS
• PDF: Best for printing
• JPEG and PNG format
• MP4 for video
